ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Registry Modification From ADS Via Regini.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the import of an alternate data stream with regini.exe, regini.exe can be used to modify registry keys.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\regini\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGINI\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(":[^ \]"))
